![Banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Beautiful_Enchanted_Books/BH_BEB_header1.webp) 本模组旨在改善附魔书的外观，现在每一本都将独一无二！ 我们还添加了对超过 85 个模组的支持，包括：
展开查看 Ad Astra: Giselle Addon, Additional Additions, Additional Enchanted Miner, Alex's Caves, Alex's Caves: Stuff & Torpedoes, Alex's Mobs, Alexs Caves Exemplified, Allurement, Apotheosis, Apothic Enchanting, Apothic Spawners, Ars Additions, Ars Elemental, Ars Nouveau, Arthropofia, AzureLib, Backpacked, Better Archeology, Better End, BetterNether, Biome Makeover, Box of Horros, Celestisynth, Clutter, CoFH Core, Combat Roll, Corail Tombstone, Create, Create Stuff & Additions, Darker Depths, Death Knights, Deep Aether, Deeper and Darker, Draconic Evolution, EnderIO, Ensorcellation, Eternal Starlight, EvilCraft, Farmer's Delight, Fins and Tails, Forbidden Arcanus, Galosphere, gofish, Golden Foods, Hunter's Return, Jaden's Nether Expansion, Just a lot more enchantments, Just Enough Guns, Kobolds, Malum, Midnight, MineColonies, My Nether Delight, Mystical Agriculture, Mythic Charms, MythicBotania, Nature's Aura, Nether Depths Upgrade, Opposint Forge, Piglin Proliferation, Railcraft Reborn, Reliquary Reincarnations, Species, Spawner+, Spell Engine, Spell Power Attribute, Stalwart Dungeons, Stellarity, Supplementaries, Terramity, The Bumblezone, The Deep Void, The End of Herobrine, The Twilight Forest, The Undergarden, The Undead Revamp, Things, Too Many Bows, Trials Chambers, Unusual Fish, UtilitiX, Vampirism, Vein Mining, When Dungeons Arise and You're in Grave Danger and Yomai Style.
这是 Minecraft 社区无数次向创作者提出的需求，因为这样他们就能让每本书看起来各不相同。为此，我们制作了这款精美的资源包，为每本书提供了与其主题相契合的独特纹理。 此前我们发布过一款资源包，但从第一个版本开始，我们就收到了无数将其转换为模组且不依赖其他模组即可运行的请求……如今，它终于来了！本模组无需安装任何其他模组即可直接修改书籍外观！ ### 需要服务器与好友一起游玩吗？
